item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
The newly released leaders of the “cockroach” movement have reignited street protests in Delhi, while fresh Kuki‑Naga clashes in Manipur have left nine dead and prompted the chief minister to call for peace. Violence remains high in Kashmir and the Maoist‑affected belt, adding to overall volatility across the country. The resurgence of protests and the spike in Manipur killings represent a sharp escalation compared with the earlier assessment, which noted only a general increase in tension. The UCDP recorded 437 battle‑related deaths in 2024, underscoring the broader conflict intensity.
